test_HookRegistry_init: test the HookRegistry class initializes with empty loaded_hooks and _handlers
test_discover_and_load_valid_hook: test HookRegistry.discover_and_load discovers and loads a valid hook from a directory with HOOK.yaml and handler.py
test_emit_sync_handler: test HookRegistry.emit calls a synchronous handler function when an event is emitted
test_emit_async_handler: test HookRegistry.emit calls an asynchronous handler function when an event is emitted
test_wildcard_event_matching: test HookRegistry.emit matches wildcard event patterns like command:* against specific events
